items.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the Europe (Milan) and Europe (Spain) regions. These instances are powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors available only on AWS.

items.title: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery introduces Recovery Plans for orchestrated application recovery
items.blurb: AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (AWS DRS) now offers Recovery Plans, a capability that automates the sequential launch of multi-server applications during recovery and drills.

items.title: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP now supports copying backups across AWS Regions and accounts
items.blurb: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, a fully managed shared storage service built on NetApp's popular ONTAP file system, now supports copying backups within and across AWS Regions, and across trusted accounts in your AWS organization.

items.title: Google Cloud Launches AI-powered Agents to Simplify Database Lifecycle Management
items.blurb: Google Cloud has introduced AI-powered Database Operations Agents, featuring an Onboarding Agent that streamlines database setup and an Observability Agent that helps automate troubleshooting, performance optimization, and tuning.

items.title: Amazon Redshift integrates with Agent Toolkit for AWS for AI-assisted data warehouse management
items.blurb: Amazon Redshift now integrates with the Agent Toolkit for AWS , enabling you to build, query, troubleshoot, and migrate to Amazon Redshift data warehouses and date lakes directly from AI agents such as Claude Code, Kiro, and Cursor.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands conversational analytics capabilities in the Africa (Cape Town) Region
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now supports generative AI-powered summaries, real-time call analytics, and real-time rules in the Africa (Cape Town) Region.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now automatically refreshes scheduling metrics
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now automatically refreshes schedule metrics on the scheduling page, giving managers immediate visibility into the impact of schedule updates.
